task: Question: On the BBC Earth YouTube video of the Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments, what species of bird is featured?

agents.name: video_searcher
agents.instruction: Use websearch-tavily to locate the BBC Earth YouTube video titled (or clearly matching) "Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments". Return a JSON object containing at minimum: video_title (exact YouTube page title), video_url (full HTTPS URL), youtube_id (if retrievable), and a one-sentence rationale showing which search result you selected (e.g., matching title/channel). Write your result to the session state under the output_key.

output_contract.description: Canonical identification of the target YouTube video.

agents.name: video_inspector
agents.instruction: Read {search_result} and locate the field video_url in that object. Using the video URL from {search_result}, inspect the BBC Earth YouTube video (use the media tool primarily; if needed, use download or web-scraping to retrieve captions/transcript or specific page elements). Identify whether a bird appears in the video and, if so, determine the species of that bird. Return a JSON object with these required fields: bird_species (common name; if a scientific name is available include it in parentheses), timestamp (the timestamp(s) where the bird appears, e.g., "1:23-1:30"), evidence_items (an array; each item should include kind: one of ["frame_image_url","timestamped_video_url","transcript_snippet"], value: the evidence URL or snippet, and short_description). If you used a transcript or captions, include the transcript snippet with its timestamp. Place your output in session state under the output_key.

output_contract.description: Observed species and supporting evidence extracted from the video.

input_requirements.purpose: Use the canonical video_url to download/inspect the video and to form timestamped evidence links.

evidence_requirements.task_quote: On the BBC Earth YouTube video of the Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments, what species of bird is featured?

agents.name: synthesizer
agents.instruction: Read {search_result} and {video_inspection}. Verify that the reported bird_species from {video_inspection} is supported by the provided evidence_items and by the video_url from {search_result}. If the species is clearly supported, produce a concise final answer that states the species (common name; include scientific name if available), the timestamp(s) where it appears, and 1-2 supporting evidence items (exact timestamped URL or transcript snippet). If the species cannot be confidently determined from the evidence, say 'unresolved' and list what is missing. Return plain JSON with fields: final_species (value or 'unresolved'), confidence (high/medium/low), support (array of cited evidence items copied from {video_inspection}), and notes (brief explanation). This agent's output is the terminal caller-facing answer.

input_requirements.purpose: Use extracted species and supporting evidence to form the final answer.

task: Question: In the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM, what is the highest number of bird species to be on camera simultaneously?

agents.name: video_reader
agents.instruction: Read and inspect the video referenced in the user's query: {user_query}. Extract the canonical video URL and YouTube ID, download the video (or stream frames), locate all segments where birds are visible, and produce a compact, machine-readable extraction containing: video_id (YouTube ID), video_url, a list video_frames_or_clips[] where each item includes a timestamp range, a short description, and a local file path or media handle for the frame/clip; and visual_evidence_for_identification[] containing cropped image files or frame file paths suitable for species identification. Return only the required fields in JSON form and include provenance (how frames were selected). Use available media analysis tools to capture frame images. Do not attempt to identify species — only produce visual evidence and timestamps that downstream agents will use.

output_contract.description: Video-level extraction and visual evidence for downstream species identification.

evidence_requirements.task_quote: Question: In the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM, what is the highest number of bird species to be on camera simultaneously?

agents.name: species_identifier
agents.instruction: Using the visual evidence and frames provided in {video_extraction}, examine each frame/clip and identify bird species present. For every video_frames_or_clips[] item from {video_extraction}, produce an entry with: timestamp (matching the frame/clip), frame_id or file path, species_detected[] where each item contains species_name (common name; include scientific name if confidently known), a short justification/evidence statement referencing the visual evidence (describe distinguishing marks, plumage, size, or other cues), and a confidence score (high/medium/low) for the identification. Also produce unique_species_list[] (alphabetical) and ensure you preserve the video_id identity field. Use the media tool to inspect the provided images/clips; do not re-run broad web searches for species unless a clear visual match cannot be determined (note such unresolved items). Return JSON with the required fields.

output_contract.description: Per-frame species identifications derived from the visual evidence.

input_requirements.purpose: Use these frames and visual crops to identify species per timestamp.

agents.name: aggregator_calculator
agents.instruction: Compute the highest number of distinct bird species visible on camera simultaneously using the per-frame species lists in {identifications}. Treat entries with the same timestamp (or overlapping timestamp ranges) as simultaneous; if identifications are per-frame, use each frame timestamp as an instant. Return: max_simultaneous_species (integer count), timestamps[] (list of timestamp(s) where this maximum occurs), species_at_max[] (the list of species present at the time(s) of maximum), and video_id (copied from {identifications}). Explain briefly how ties were handled and list any unresolved identifications that prevent a conclusive maximum. Use a short, exact numeric result and include the supporting timestamps and species lists. Perform the numeric computation programmatically or with sandbox-light as needed and set calculation_result_field to max_simultaneous_species.

output_contract.description: Numeric and supporting result: highest simultaneous species count with timestamps and species lists.

input_requirements.purpose: Compute the maximum number of distinct species visible at the same time from the per-frame identifications.

task: Question: On the BBC Earth YouTube video of the Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments, what species of bird is featured?

agents.name: video_finder
agents.instruction: Search the web (prioritize BBC Earth and YouTube) for the BBC Earth YouTube video titled (or clearly matching) "Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments". Return a small JSON object with: video_url (the canonical YouTube URL you will use), video_title (YouTube title), channel (should be BBC Earth if matched), and a one-line reason why you selected that URL (e.g., exact title match, channel match). Keep results concise and include at least one candidate URL. Use the websearch-tavily tool for discovery.

output_contract.description: Selected candidate video URL and minimal identifying metadata for downstream inspection.

agents.name: video_inspector
agents.instruction: Inspect the candidate video from {finder_result}. Using the value(s) in {finder_result.video_url} (or the first video_url if multiple), do the following evidence-first: (1) Load and scrape the YouTube page to extract the video description, visible transcript (YouTube transcript), and any captions/description lines that mention animals or bird names. (2) Use the media tool to analyze the video (via the URL) and examine frames around timestamps where birds appear to produce short image descriptions that support species identification. (3) Combine visual observations, transcript lines, and description text to identify the species of bird featured in the clip (give common name and scientific name if available). Return a structured JSON object with these required fields: video_url, identified_species (object with common_name and scientific_name if found; if uncertain mark unresolved), evidence_timestamps (list of timestamps with short reason), transcript_excerpts (list of timestamped transcript lines used), image_descriptions (list of timestamped frame descriptions from media analysis), and sources (list of source URLs used, including the YouTube URL). If you cannot confirm species from these sources, mark identified_species as unresolved and explain what is missing. Use web-scraping for page/text extraction and media for frame-level inspection. Prioritize direct evidence from the video (visual frames and transcript) over secondary pages.

output_contract.description: Species identification and supporting evidence extracted from the YouTube video and its transcript/frames.

input_requirements.purpose: Use the selected YouTube URL and title as the target to inspect.

task: Question: In the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM, what is the highest number of bird species to be on camera simultaneously?

agents.name: video_reader
agents.instruction:
You are given the user's question in {user_query}. Inspect and analyze the referenced YouTube video URL inside that query. Use the media tool to watch and analyze the video frames. Your primary goal is to determine the single highest number of distinct bird species that appear simultaneously on camera at any time in the video. Produce a JSON object (not free text) with the following fields: 

- highest_simultaneous_species_count (integer): the maximum number of distinct bird species visible on screen at the same moment.
- timestamps (array of objects): each object should have {start, end} in HH:MM:SS or seconds where the maximum occurs (if multiple separate moments tie for the maximum, include each).
- species_list (array of strings): the common names of all distinct species that are visible together at one of the maximum timestamps. If multiple max moments have different compositions, include one species_list per timestamp in the same order as timestamps.
- evidence_clips (array of local file paths or media-tool clip identifiers): the short video frame(s) or clip file paths showing the maximum moment(s). If the media tool returns thumbnail/frame captures, include their paths.
- method_and_uncertainty (string): short note describing how you identified species (visual markers, audio if used), any ambiguous IDs and confidence level per ambiguous species.

Notes: prioritize direct visual evidence from the video (frames/clips). When reporting species names, use common English names and include scientific name only if identification is ambiguous. If you cannot access or analyze the video, return a JSON with these fields set to null and an explanation in method_and_uncertainty. Output must satisfy the output_contract required fields exactly.

output_contract.description: Structured extraction of the peak simultaneous bird-species observation from the supplied video.

evidence_requirements.task_quote: Question: In the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM, what is the highest number of bird species to be on camera simultaneously?

agents.name: answerer
agents.instruction: Read the structured video analysis artifact in {video_analysis}. Produce a concise, user-facing answer to the original question in plain text. The answer must start with the numeric highest number (e.g., 'Highest simultaneous species on camera: 4') followed by: (1) the timestamp(s) where that maximum occurs, (2) the list of species seen together at that timestamp (common names), and (3) a one- or two-sentence summary of the evidence (referencing the evidence_clips paths). If any required field from {video_analysis} is null or unresolved, state that the result is unresolved and explain why using the method_and_uncertainty field. Use the video_analysis fields only; do not perform new web searches.

input_requirements.purpose: Use the structured findings and evidence paths from the video analysis to produce the final user-facing answer.
